payload.rationale: This document is a forget/retract directive from Xena ExpertGH, the same actor who previously issued the Kestrelwood spectrograph forget-lifecycle (original assertions followed by total revocation, removal instructions, and denial of history). I expanded the actor node and all five of its expression children to surface the full forget-lifecycle pattern — original specification, calibration claim, then the three retract expressions (total revocation, complete removal, denial of history) — so the passes can recognize this document as the same directive type applied to new content (Zeppelin fleet, helium contracts, routes). I expanded the InstrumentCalibrationVerification narrative and the KestrelwoodSpectrographCalibrationStatus position because they show how a retract directive revises both a narrative (dropping original members, adding the denial) and a position (same revision pattern), which the passes will need to replicate for any Zeppelin-related positions or narratives this document creates or retracts. I deliberately did not expand the onboarding checklist narrative or position (^Narrative_StructuredOnboardingChecklists, ^Position_NewHireOnboardingChecklist) as they bear no overlap with this document's subject matter.
